verdict.rationale: The only scheduling-adjacent evidence is Warehouse Connectors. Their Mirror mode implies recurring syncs from Snowflake or Databricks: the docs warn that the Mixpanel sync must not lapse beyond the change-tracking retention window. Marketing copy also says agents 'monitor your product continuously'. Missing for 10: user-configurable scheduling of recurring jobs or workflows, scheduled report or alert delivery, documented sync-frequency controls, API or MCP-driven scheduling, and any independent corroboration.
